name: klay37
caption:
KLAY'S QUARTER 🎮🏀 The night our guy couldn't miss. January 23, 2015 vs the Kings. Third quarter.

• 13-for-13 from the field
• 9-for-9 from three
• 37 points in one quarter, still the NBA record
• 52 for the night, and we win 126-101

Will anyone ever take our record? 👇
